Analysts recommend IRCTC, other travel stocks as 'Buy'

Analysts have initiated coverage on Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) with a 'Buy' recommendation and a target price of ₹560. The valuation is based on 25 times the average of estimated earnings for FY28 and FY29. IRCTC is listed among other travel stocks, including Ixigo, RateGain, and TBO Tek, identified as top stocks to purchase.
